latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the find-skills skill.
- Enables searching and discovering OpenClaw skills from multiple sources including ClawHub, OpenClaw Directory, LobeHub, GitHub, and community forums.
- Provides usage guidance, best practices, troubleshooting tips, and example search strategies.
- Lists common skill categories and related skills for easier discovery and navigation.
- Includes detailed recommendations for when and when not to use this skill.
